name: 财务链 (7UU)
description_en_html:
Overview

A Financial Chain is a business object that represents an intercompany commercial chain (which is represented by various companies), comprising a sequence of steps depicting a buy sell relationship within a corporate group with flow of Value and Services.

In this process, you can create a Financial Chain as a master data to represent the various entities which are part of multistage intercompany sales or multistage stock transfer. Thereafter, materials assigned to Financial Chains help the multistage intercompany sales or multistage intercompany stock transfer process to be orchestrated.

Key Process Flow

  • Create Financial Chain for multistage intercompany sales and multistage stock transfer process with Active and Release Status
  • Mark Financial Chain as Obsolete (Optional)
  • Assign material to Financial Chains
  • Mass Upload of Material Assignment to Financial Chains (Optional)
  • Managing various lifecycle status for Material Assignment to Financial Chain (Active, Release)
  • Marking Material Assignment to Financial Chain as Obsolete (Optional)

Business Benefits

The creation of Financial Chain and subsequent assignment of material to Financial Chain allows you to orchestrate the multistage intercompany sales and multistage intercompany stock transfer processes. You can manage the various lifecycle status for Financial Chain, as well as assignment of material to Financial Chain.
description_zh_html:
概览

财务链是表示公司间商业链（由不同公司表示）的业务对象，由一系列步骤组成，描述公司集团内的买卖关系以及价值和服务流。

在此流程中，您可以创建财务链作为主数据，以表示属于多级公司间销售或多阶段库存转储的各种实体。此后，分配到财务链的物料有助于多级公司间销售或多阶段公司间库存转储流程进行协调。

关键流程流

  • 为多级公司间销售和多阶段库存转储流程创建财务链，具有活动和审批状态
  • 将财务链标记为作废（可选）
  • 将物料分配到财务链
  • 批量上载物料分配到财务链（可选）
  • 管理物料分配到财务链的各种生命周期状态（活动、发布）
  • 将物料分配标记为作废（可选）

业务优势

通过创建财务链和后续将物料分配到财务链，您可以协调多级公司间销售和多阶段公司间库存转储流程。您可以管理财务链的各种生命周期状态，以及物料到财务链的分配。
